This page links to all instructions and other information about course assignments. All deadlines are found on the [Course Calendar](calendar.qmd).

## Labs

The general page for all [431 Labs is here](https://github.com/THOMASELOVE/431-labs-2025/blob/main/README.md). 

Two special assignments are:

- [Welcome to 431 Survey](https://bit.ly/431-2025-welcome)
    - Note: You must log into Google via CWRU in order to access the Survey.
    - This assignment is due on the day after our first class, but do it now.
- [Lab X](https://github.com/THOMASELOVE/431-labs-2025/tree/main/labX) (Developing a Personal Website) on Github (you can start and even complete this now, but it isn't due until late in the semester)
